rows.grounds: adverb introducing the summary of the preceding instruction
object of ākhyātaṃ; channel for water
locative of place; padma and madhya compound

items.question: Where is the water-spout declared to be placed especially?
items.inference: The water-spout is to be placed especially in the middle of the lotus.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of padma is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: Thus the water-spout is declared, especially in the middle of the lotus.
